description.en: Control Sky Stream and Sky Glass boxes over your local network. Full remote control (navigation, playback, colour buttons, channel and volume, digits) plus a media player with power, volume, mute and transport. Boxes are discovered automatically, and Wake-on-LAN powers them on from standby. No Sky account required - control is entirely local.

value.en: On the next screen your Sky boxes are discovered automatically. Leave the IP address blank to auto-discover, or enter it manually if discovery does not find your box. The box must be powered on (not in standby) during setup.
